label: Nature–society and risk
text: EA.O.A5.5 Nature–society and risk. Coupled human–natural systems: pressure, state, impact and response, under a stated boundary. This absorbs environmental science claims (Grok "EV"). Risk = hazard × exposure × vulnerability (IPCC AR6 WGII glossary). Vulnerability is the propensity to be adversely affected: sensitivity plus lack of capacity to cope and adapt. Exposure is a separate factor. The hazard cites EA.O.A2 or A4. Policy is PO; price is EC; duty is LA. Population counts are MS.O.A5.
